source_refs.note: Roman Urdu overview of the properties of transition elements (PDF 19).

blocks.text: Transition elements ki pehli qatar titanium se copper tak hai. In ki mushtarka tabeei aur kimiyai khasiyatein in ke kuch bhare 3d orbitals se paida hoti hain.

items: Tabeei: sakht, ghani, oonche darje par pighalne wali aur achhi conductor dhaatein (18.2.1).
Kimiyai: badalte oxidation states, complex ions, rangeen compounds aur catalyst ka kaam (18.2.2 se 18.2.4).

blocks.prompt: 3d anasir ki khaas khasiyaton ke zimmedar kaun se electrons hain?

items: Ti se Cu ki khasiyatein kuch bhare 3d orbitals se.
